hook_text: Three bean plants. One gets no light, one gets no water. Guess which one wins.
clip_script: Three bean plants in Pietermaritzburg. Pot A: dark cupboard. Two weeks later? Tall, thin and yellow. It needed light! Pot B: no water. Droopy, then brown and crispy. It needed water! Pot C: sunny window and water every day. Green, strong and leaning to the light. Then cover the leaves in petroleum jelly. They turn yellow. Leaves need air through tiny holes! Light, water, air. Change one thing at a time, and the plants tell you the answer.
visual_style: Whiteboard row of three pots on a windowsill and in a cupboard; one plant grows tall and pale, one wilts, one stands green and strong.
mood: Like a science race, with a clear winner.
pacing: Set up the three pots, fast-forward a week, then reveal what each one needed.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and plan your own fair test with three plants.
